title: Gorenstein Prüfer domains with non-Prüfer integral closure
summary: There exists a one-dimensional local Gorenstein Prüfer domain whose integral closure is not Prüfer. We prove that the recently constructed coherent counterexample to the normalization problem has this stronger Gorenstein property. The argument establishes permanence of divisoriality of finitely generated ideals under ultraproducts and quotients by divided primes. It also supplies uniform matrix factorizations: in an ultraproduct of plane-curve domains, every nonzero ideal generated by $r$ elements is a cycle of a two-periodic totally acyclic complex with free terms of rank $r$.
